record.question: Who topped in the Hurun's Global Rich List 2018?
record.explanation: Answer C: Jeff Bezos. Hurun’s 28 February 2018 release places Jeff Bezos first in its Global Rich List 2018, using a 31 January wealth snapshot. Historical/source note: This is the 2018 list’s snapshot, not a current richest-person claim. Reference: https://www.hurun.net/en-us/info/detail?num=2B1B8F33F9C0. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
